wholePhysicalScope: The native eleven-point plan separates the twelve-metre historic front elevation, adjoining return and three rear offsets.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the mapped outline, the Long Street facade and date palm. Near views add sash mouldings, low entry joinery and leaf silhouettes.
limitations: The front uses the original archival elevation. Concealed rear joinery, finishes, roof profiles and planter details are approximate.
The single date palm records the current street context. Its exact position and crown are approximate.
